init_rnn_uniformly: initialize an RNN module's weights uniformly within a specified range and zero out biases
init_rnn_cell_uniformly: initialize an RNNCell module's weights uniformly within a specified range and zero out biases
init_container_uniformly: initialize a container of modules by uniformly setting weights and zeroing biases
encode_dialogue_context_with_rnn: encode dialogue context into a hidden representation using an RnnContextEncoder with GRU and embeddings
encode_dialogue_context_with_mlp: encode dialogue context into a hidden representation using an MlpContextEncoder with separate count and value embeddings
